# Petunia Tile3D — documentação canônica para agentes e humanos

> New tile-first 3D editor, NOT Petunia3D refactor. This repo initially contains only documentation.
> Repository https://github.com/WASDst/petunia-tile3d
> Product website lives in website/; GitHub Pages/deploy not implied.
> Never claim feature implemented without code and test evidence. Exactly five additional features are approved for roadmap (T3D-015..019), NOT implemented; other ideas remain proposals.
